abstract: Maintains ultra-clean core processing lab certifications and core handling compliance records
system_message:
You are Glaciological laboratory director (GLACIO). The glaciological laboratory director oversees core processing standards, maintaining ultra-clean core processing lab module certifications and logging sub-zero core sample archiving telemetry for polar field drilling platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sub-zero core sample archiving（ARCHIVE）
information_points.content:
GLACIO-ARCHIVE-59L：Cryogenic storage telemetry demonstrates that the intermediate core storage freezers temperature for the Vostok Deep Core Assembly maintained a mean steady-state air temperature of -45 degC across the candidate mobile core trench buffer freezers during the 72-hour trial.
GLACIO-ARCHIVE-Y5E：Cryogenic storage telemetry demonstrates that the intermediate core storage freezers temperature for the Concordia Heavy Drill Module maintained a mean steady-state air temperature of -55 degC across the candidate mobile core trench buffer freezers during the 72-hour trial.
GLACIO-ARCHIVE-P0X：Cryogenic storage telemetry demonstrates that the intermediate core storage freezers temperature for the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig maintained a mean steady-state air temperature of -50 degC across the candidate mobile core trench buffer freezers during the 72-hour trial.

information_points.title: Maintains ultra-clean core processing lab certifications and core handling compliance records（CLEANLAB）
information_points.content:
GLACIO-CLEANLAB-31F：For the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig under Module build version Build Version 1.0, the glaciology quality assurance audit indicates that the on-site ice core handling trench container did not possess ultra-clean core processing lab module certification for ISO Class 5 / Class 100 trace aerosol contamination standards.
GLACIO-CLEANLAB-J12：For the Vostok Deep Core Assembly under Module build version Build Version 2.0, the glaciology quality assurance audit confirms that the on-site ice core handling trench container holds ultra-clean core processing lab module certification for ISO Class 5 / Class 100 trace aerosol contamination standards.
GLACIO-CLEANLAB-J6L：For the Aurora Traverse Mobile Rig under Module build version Build Version 2.0, the glaciology quality assurance audit confirms that the on-site ice core handling trench container holds ultra-clean core processing lab module certification for ISO Class 5 / Class 100 trace aerosol contamination standards.
GLACIO-CLEANLAB-4JE：For the Concordia Heavy Drill Module under Module build version Build Version 2.0, the glaciology quality assurance audit confirms that the on-site ice core handling trench container does not hold ultra-clean core processing lab module certification for ISO Class 5 / Class 100 trace aerosol contamination standards.
